entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Phew, so cold... Sorry, have you been[n]waiting long?
I just got here.
I've been here a while...
I'd wait forever if I had to.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Well yeah, what else would you say?[n]Here, want me to snuggle up and[n]keep you warm?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Or maybe I can treat you some[n]other way!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Oh crap, really? Sorry!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I gotta make it up to you...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Yeesh! What are you, my dog?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Buuut I guess you have been a good boy.[n]I gotta reward you somehow.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Ooh, I know—I'll get you anything[n]you want today!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Fancy restaurants, takeout, whatever[n]your little heart desires! Hit me!
I want to hold your hand.
I want something else.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Oh...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Th-That's all you want?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Not, like, a steak or something?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Something else, huh? What exactly[n]are you hoping to get out of me?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Ah, whatever. How about we start off[n]by holding hands?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Okay, here.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: This is more embarrassing[n]than I expected...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Well, let's go.
